prophecy.subtitle: Six claims about the future. You say how likely you think each one is.
prophecy.howItWorks: When it settles, every guess gets a Brier score: (your probability − what happened)². Zero is perfect, 0.25 is a coin flip.

classroom.title: Classroom mode
classroom.subtitle: Create a class code. Students play like everyone else, and you get to see how your class answered next to the planet.
classroom.step1: Generate a code and put it on the board.
classroom.step2: Students open the play link with the code and play a round.
classroom.step3: The class results page compares your class with the planet.
classroom.labelHint: Anyone with the code sees it. Don't put names here.
classroom.codeHint: The code is the key. Whoever has it sees the class results, and nothing else.
classroom.keepIt: Save the code. Without it you can't reach the class results, because we remember nothing about you.
classroom.privacy: We store no names, no emails and no IP addresses. A class is just a label on votes that would exist anyway.
classroom.tooSmallText: Results appear from {min} votes. {missing} to go. Below that it stops being an overview and becomes a description of particular people.
classroom.noWeighting: A class is not weighted. Weighting projects a sample onto a population, and a class is not a sample of anything — so this is the raw number only.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.subtitle: Every number on this page is generated from the same constants the code uses. Change the code and this page changes too.
methodology.axesText: Every option carries weights on three axes (−1 to +1). Axis score = sum of chosen weights divided by the maximum possible absolute sum in the round.
methodology.realismText: Realism = mean over meta questions of 1 − |guess − actual| / 100. Actual is the weighted share at submit time; after the round closes it is recomputed to the final value.
methodology.consistencyText: Consistency = 1 − (activated contradiction pairs / pairs in the round). A pair activates when both tense options are chosen.
methodology.compromiseText: Compromise = share of chosen options marked as compromises.
methodology.survivalText: Survival index = {c} × consistency + {k} × compromise + {r} × realism. Without realism data the remaining weights are renormalised.
methodology.archetypeText: Archetypes are assigned by rules over the axes, top-down; first match wins, the last rule is the fallback.
methodology.countryWeightText: Country weight = (country population / world population) / (country votes / total votes), clamped to {lo}–{hi}. Countries with fewer than {min} votes get weight 1 and a “small sample” label.
methodology.rakingText: Inside a country with at least {min} votes with demographics: raking on age × gender against target shares (World Bank), at most {iter} iterations, tolerance {tol}. Factors trimmed to {lo}–{hi}.
methodology.normalizationText: Final weight = the product, normalised so that the sum of weights equals the number of votes.
methodology.trustText: A suspicious vote is never blocked, only flagged and kept out of public numbers: honeypot (a nonsense option), submitting within {fast} s of loading, more than {ip} votes per hour from one IP fingerprint, more than {anon} per hour from one device, declared vs detected country mismatch. The only hard block is a duplicate: one vote per person per round.
methodology.privacyText: We store no IP address (only a salted fingerprint), no User-Agent (only a coarse browser family) and nothing personal. Demographics are optional and coarse. The verified layer stores an identity fingerprint, never a name or e-mail.
methodology.contradictionText: A country's or the planet's contradiction index = weighted share of votes that activated at least one contradiction pair.
methodology.unlockText: A country appears on the leaderboard, in titles and on the map only after {threshold} votes in a round.
methodology.sourcesText: Population and age structure: World Bank (WB API); country codes and names: world-countries (ODbL); map: Natural Earth.
